icicle noun

also icicles

classical

Traupman 136, 331
Verg. G. 3.366

stīria, stīriae f.

noun, first declension

(poetic and post-Augustan prose (L&S))

Examples

  • Numquam vīdistī stīriās dē tēctīs dēpendentēs?

    Have you never seen icicles hanging from a roof?Traupman 134

  • Ecce, stīriae dē tēctō pendent!

    Look, icicles hanging from the roof!composed

See also freeze.

SourcesLewis & Short: stiria

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 134, 136, 331.
